titulo: Added antibody step improves the reliability of Alzheimer's blood tests
resumo: Researchers at University Medicine Halle have developed a new method that could improve the reliability of blood tests for Alzheimer's disease. Current commercial tests often rely on the protein biomarker p-tau217, whose levels can rise in the early stages of the disease. However, the biomarker levels can also be elevated in other conditions, potentially leading to false-positive results. In a study involving 315 participants, the research team demonstrated improved accuracy in distinguishing Alzheimer's disease from other conditions. Their findings have been published in Nature Communications.

titulo: Stellar collisions may have been common when the universe was young
resumo: In our solar system's corner of the galaxy, stars rarely collide. It makes sense: Space is vast, and stars have room to roam. Even in most of the present-day universe, stellar collisions are rare. The James Webb Space Telescope, however, peers deep enough into space to see the universe as it was not too long after the Big Bang. Its observations have revealed extraordinarily compact stellar systems, raising the possibility that collisions between stars were once much more common.

titulo: Systemd adds support for components written in Rust

Rust will be used only for new leaf components, existing code is not being ported to Rust and nothing that other components depend on is written in Rust. Brauner said that the project would like to move forward with Rust support in core systemd, " but there are several blockers in Rust's support for dynamic libraries which prevents us from doing that without massively bloating every binary we build ". Assuming all goes well, it seems likely this work will appear in the systemd v263 release expected in December.

Com isso, a ferramenta também conseguiu reconstruir o contexto das conversas e criar uma nova sessão funcional do chatbot. Para testar a ferramenta, a equipe liderada pelo doutorando Ken Xu criou um assistente fictício chamado Project Note Keeper no aplicativo de código aberto ChatterUI. Ambos se passam como executáveis legítimos para instalar um programa no Windows, mas estão corrompidos. O script se conecta com um trojan chamado Overlord RAT, no qual é possível controlar o computador remotamente após instalar um vírus no sistema. A análise de código da ameaça registrou algumas verificações de referências a apps de bancos e instituições financeiras brasileiras.
